text:
ara: kicking off onboarding for cedar-0.3 embed. Quick smoke: fp16 recall@5=0.828, int8 baseline recall@5=0.789. Not huge but short-query cohort drops more (~8%). anyone available to triage? cc @vince @joan

vince: thanks. first checks: (1) are you L2-normalizing pre or post quant? (2) what index metric?

ara: we normalize after quant. index uses HNSW with angular. holdout 15k mix, short queries = token_count < 8. run id r-202405-cedar-quick1

joan: normalize after quant can hide quant bias. try pre-normalize -> quant -> renormalize. also test asymmetric per-channel quant if possible.

ara: noted. int8 used symmetric per-channel, clip=0.9995. will run asymmetric next.

pete: also look at per-dim variance. short queries often rely on few high-signal dims; quant clamping those dims kills top1. can you share top-10 dims by variance?\nara: pasted quick stats in repo (link wip). top dims: [12, 7, 3, 45, 101] high skew.

eval-bot: nightly-eval r-202405-cedar-quick1: recall@1=0.603, recall@5=0.789, recall@10=0.835 (fp16 baseline recall@5=0.828). Full results: https://ci.internal/bench/r-202405-cedar

vince: try two quick experiments tonight: 1) pre-normalize then quant and 2) asymmetric per-channel with bias correction. use scripts/quant_explore.py --mode prenorm,asym --calib 50k

joan: also add id-flip logging and cluster the flips. if flips concentrate in a few product areas we can consider selective fp16 fallback for those clusters.

ara: running prenorm + asym now. also enabling stochastic rounding. will post results here.

vince: if prenorm helps, consider keeping an FP16 copy of top-k dims (like top-64) and quant the rest. hybrid often recovers short-query UX with small storage cost.

pete: small idea: compute distance margin (top1-top2). if margin < 0.02 trigger fp16 lookup. cheap protective policy.

ara: added margin logging. initial prenorm+asym+stochastic: recall@5=0.815, short cohort recall@5=0.810 (much better). run r-202405-cedar-quick2.

joan: promising. can you generate UMAP snapshots for fp16 vs int8 and an id-flip list for 200 random short queries?

ara: on it. attaching sample flips and UMAP link in repo. most flips cluster in two FAQ-ish clusters.

vince: schedule a small canary with hybrid storage (top-64 fp16) and margin fallback in staging. If hybrid gives similar perf and storage hit <8% we can enable for dedicated customers.

ara: will spin canary tomorrow. thanks everyone. will post final digest and metrics (recall@1/5/10, silhouette, flip clusters) in this thread.
